WITH ratio_calc AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT as ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != ''
  AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0
),
sex_averages AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM ratio_calc
  GROUP BY SEX
),
first_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean1 FROM sex_averages
),
filtered_first AS (
  SELECT sa.SEX, sa.avg_ratio
  FROM sex_averages sa, first_mean_val fm
  WHERE sa.avg_ratio > fm.mean1
),
second_mean_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean2 FROM filtered_first
),
filtered_second AS (
  SELECT ff.SEX, ff.avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_first ff, second_mean_val sm
  WHERE ff.avg_ratio > sm.mean2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as final_avg,
  AVG(avg_ratio) - (SELECT mean1 FROM first_mean_val) as avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(avg_ratio) - (SELECT mean2 FROM second_mean_val) as avg_excess_over_second
FROM filtered_second
